PRIVILEGED & CONFIDENTIAL — ATTORNEY WORK PRODUCT

MEMORANDUM

TO:      Litigation Team
FROM:    Naomi Fairbanks-Oyelaran
DATE:    2025.03.18
RE:      New matter intake – Desmond Achebe-Kowalczyk v. Pellucid Freight Systems, Inc. (our ref. M-25-0331)

1. Client details

Our client, Desmond Achebe-Kowalczyk (DOB 07.11.1968), lives at 83 Lantern Hill Terrace, Unit 12, Marietta, GA 30064-3317. He can be reached on 4045550127 (cell) or at desmond.ak@inbox.example.org. He previously lived in Canada at 2210 Rue Sainte-Catherine Ouest, Montréal, QC H3H 1M7 and still holds a Canadian Social Insurance Number, 046 454 286.

2. The dispute

Desmond drove for Pellucid from Feb. 3, 2021 to Nov. 30, 2024. Pellucid's dispatcher, Grete Mauldin, deducted fuel costs from his settlements without authorisation. Total deductions per his spreadsheet: USD 27,413.06. Reimbursements were paid to his checking acct. 000123456789 at Peachtree Community Bank.

3. Payment card

He used a company fuel card ending 1117; the full number on the statement is 6011 1111 1111 1117.

4. Opposing counsel

Bartholomew Quist, Quist Harrow & Lyle LLP, (678) 555-0110. He has asked for an extension until April 15, 2025.

5. Next steps

Conflicts check cleared on 3/17/25. Engagement letter to go out under the standard terms (Fee Schedule B). Prepare a demand under O.C.G.A. § 34-7-2 and the Fair Labor Standards Act.

N.F.
